content: not sure how you'd disable wayland for standard proton but basically all other proton implementations have the `PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND`/`PROTON_USE_WAYLAND` environment variable so you can set your steam launch parameters to `PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND=0 %command%` (it can also be added to `STEAM_COMPAT_CONFIG` as `wayland`, which is also a non-standard option)
